title: convolvulus acutangulus
intro: Convolvulus acutangulus, commonly known as Five-angled Morning Glory, is a plant species in the Convolvulaceae family. It is used in traditional medicine due to its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and exhibiting antiseptic properties. The therapeutic actions of Convolvulus acutangulus include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which may help in alleviating conditions such as fever and pain. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties and may be responsible for its therapeutic actions.
